prompt: wasm binary format name section placement ordering requirement
answer:
The WebAssembly **name section** is a custom section. It:

- **Should appear at most once** in a module.
- **Must/should occur after the data section**.
- Has section ID **0**, but custom-section ID does not determine its ordering; custom sections may generally be inserted anywhere, subject to the name section’s placement requirement.

Sources: [WebAssembly Custom Sections](https://webassembly.github.io/spec/core/appendix/custom.html), [WebAssembly Modules](https://webassembly.github.io/spec/core/binary/modules.html).
